📁 Using file sharing

With the file sharing service you can share files securely by setting a download limit and an expiration time if needed.

1. Select a file

Start by selecting a file from your device that you want to share with the recipient.

2. Set limits (Optional)

You can improve the security of the share by setting limits to it:

  • Download limit: Determine how many times the file can be downloaded before the link stops working.
  • Expiration time: Set a time limit after which the file can no longer be downloaded.

3. Create and share the link

Create a share link and copy it for yourself. You can forward the link via email or instant messenger, for example.
